Wissmach.result: A copper-sulfide reaction may occur. Wissmach notes results are not uniform and vary by batch, temperature and combination.

compatibility_warning: Bullseye is COE 90. Wissmach and Oceanside sheet are COE 96. Gaffer casting billet is COE 92. Reichenbach casting billet is listed as COE 96 but is a leaded casting glass, not interchangeable with COE 96 sheet. Do not mix across these in one fired piece. Reaction data is per-manufacturer and does not carry across brands.

colors.chemistry_note: Current production does not contain lead or sulfur; older stock may.

colors.name: tekta clear
colors.notes: Tekta is Bullseye’s machine-rolled flat clear, trimmed on all four sides with no rolled edge, made as an economical base or cap. Faint green tint on edge, stable, no colour shift. Bullseye notes it is not reactive, so it can sit against any colour without forming a reaction line. Brown-orange marks from the annealing belt are within their quality standard and wash off or disappear in a full fuse. Sizes 10x10 in, 17x20 in, 24x24 in, 24x48 in, 24x72 in, 40x40 in, 40x80 in; the larger sizes are will-call, freight or full case.

colors.name: crystal clear
colors.notes: Also made as Tekta, Bullseye’s machine-rolled flat clear, in 3, 4 and 6 mm up to 40x80 in. Larger sizes are will-call, freight or full case.
